column1: # The server and the grammar this engine's committed answers come from.
# default judges compat.tsv (cassandra/parser) and driver records the driver's
# Apache Cassandra 5.0.9 by digest, verified against the running container's
# image digest and SELECT release_version FROM system.local.
# grammar pins Apache Cassandra's CQL grammar, src/antlr/Cql.g, Parser.g and
# Lexer.g, at the commit of the cassandra-5.0.9 release. The digest is the
# SHA-256 of those three files, beside this one byte for byte, read one after
# the other. Cql.g4, which compat.tsv's rows are generated from, is converted
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag
